author: The Critical Drinker
description: Looking at the way this movie, and the entire DCU By James Gunn for that matter, has been handled so far, I couldn't help wondering if there was a better way to do things. A way to give the film a better chance of making money at the box office. So I figured I'd explore this topic in a little video.
title: The Drinker Fixes... Supergirl (How NOT To Tank Your Movie)
